question: Which training platform developed in 2018 by trauma surgeon Dr. Alex Young provided remote educational programmes around the world skills like the right way to wear personal protective equipment, administer treatment or ventilate a patient during COVID-19?
solution:
The correct answer is __**VIRTI**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Virti** was developed in **2018** by trauma surgeon Dr. Alex Young.
 
• Virti provides **remote educational programmes** globally, focusing on crucial skills such as wearing personal protective equipment (PPE), administering treatment, and ventilating patients.
 
• It leverages **virtual reality (VR) and artificial intelligence (AI)** to enhance the training experience.
 
• Virti became especially relevant during the **COVID-19 pandemic**, aiding healthcare workers in managing the crisis effectively.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Virtual Reality (VR) in Healthcare**

 
 
• VR technology simulates real-life scenarios, providing immersive training experiences for medical professionals.
 
• It helps in procedural training, anatomy learning, and patient interaction simulations.
 
 
 
• **Artificial Intelligence (AI) in Medical Training**
 
 
• AI enhances personalized learning by adapting training modules to individual needs.
 
• It provides real-time feedback and analytics to improve performance.
 
 
 
• **Importance of PPE Training**
 
 
• Proper use of PPE is crucial to prevent infection spread, especially during pandemics.
 
• Training ensures that healthcare workers are protected and can safely treat patients.
 
 
 
• **Impact of COVID-19 on Medical Training**
 
 
• The pandemic necessitated remote and virtual training solutions due to social distancing measures.
 
• Platforms like Virti became essential for continuous professional development and skill enhancement.
